facts.fact: Beatrice 在公交站就能看见派系大厅，手在出汗，开场即紧张的生理反应。
facts.anchor: My hands are sweaty. I can see the Hall of Factions from the bus stop

facts.fact: 今年参加 Choosing Ceremony 的十六岁孩子共九十人，比往年都少；其中 Abnegation 只占十二人。
facts.anchor: There are ninety of us, a smaller class than usual, and of those, there are only twelve from Abnegation.

facts.fact: 排队等仪式开始时，父亲伸手握了握她的手。
facts.anchor: I feel a warm hand squeeze mine: my father’s.

facts.fact: Marcus Eaton 在仪式演说里讲：创始人认为人类因共有的深重缺陷而联合，缺陷必须被纠正。
facts.anchor: Human beings are united in that they are deeply flawed.

facts.fact: 演说进行到一半，头顶所有天窗同时碎裂。
facts.anchor: And then all the skylights above us shatter at once.

facts.fact: 黑暗中有人高喊「Death to factions」，五面派系旗被割落，一面新旗升起来。
她在楼侧认出场中那个持枪的女人：Marcus 已经死去的妻子 Evelyn Eaton，如今活着。
facts.anchor: Evelyn Eaton. Marcus Eaton’s dead wife.

facts.fact: 结尾 Caleb 抱住她，告诉她 Robert 死了。
